# `nlink-lab graph`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Print topology as DOT graph

Usage: nlink-lab graph [OPTIONS] <TOPOLOGY>

Arguments:
  <TOPOLOGY>
          Path to the topology file (.nll)

Options:
      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Set a `param` value (repeatable): --set k=v

      --mermaid
          Emit a Mermaid `graph LR` block instead of DOT (renders inline in Forgejo/GitHub markdown)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
